notes.title: Version 0.9.6
notes.content:
[b]Major Changes:[/b]
- Bugfixes mostly related to UI and controller usage

notes.title: Version 0.9.5
notes.content:
[b]Major Changes:[/b]
- new boss, Inwaer The Last
- increased animation speed of two-handed weapons
- secret :)

notes.title: Version 0.9.2
notes.content:
[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
- 3 new item bonuses: Stamina Regeneration, Break Magic Resistance, Break Physical Resistance.
(Very most of enemies wearing armours have built in resistances, magical/physical, these bonuses allows to partially remove these to deal more damage)
- new base shield item: Kite Shield.
- minor bugfixes.
- slightly adjusted enemies resistances.

notes.title: Version 0.9.1
notes.content:
[b]Major Changes:[/b]
- new runewords: Dragon, Sanctuary, Void, Courage, Gloom Raiders
- added voice-overs for several NPCs
- slightly lowered stamina consumption
- slightly increased general weapon damage
- increased damage scaling of two handed weapons (newly dropped)

notes.title: Version 0.9.0
notes.content:
[b]Major Changes:[/b]
- new area - Ghan's Chapel. You can reach it from Ashen Roads of Forgotten
- new optional boss
- added game epilogue
- new base armor
- new relics

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
- updated items bonuses coloring
- minor UI/movement bugfixes
- minor optimizations

notes.title: Version 0.8.0
notes.content:
[b]Major Changes:[/b]
- new area - Castle. You can reach it from Tarc Settlement
- new boss

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
- new unique items
- new enemies

notes.title: Version 0.7.45
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
- fixed several UI bugs occuring while using controller.

[b]Minor Changes[/b]
- improved Oron's spells performance (reduced fps drop issues).
- improved general game performance on very high and ultra graphic settings.

notes.title: Version 0.7.44
notes.content:
[u][b]v0.7.44[/b][/u]
Bugfixes:
- fixed several graphical glitches in Roads of Forgotten
- fixed 'Rest' option not respawning monsters

[b][u]Major Changes:[/u][/b]
- new recipe Relict Black Diamond + 3x Athasfar => Black Catalyst Trinket
- new recipe Relict Vodoo Doll + 3x Athasfar => Voodoo Doll Trinket
- new recipe Relict Stone Tablet + 3x Athasfar => Alba's Prayer Trinket

[b][u]Minor Changes:[/u][/b]
- new items bonus +% to Health

notes.title: Version 0.7.43
notes.content:
[b][u]Major Changes:[/u][/b]
- new area - Forgotten Citadel
- new secret boss - Vhaadzaguq
- new secret gamemode - Survival - after beating Vhaadzaguq you can unlock easter egg game mode but first you need to find a key...

[u][b]Minor Changes:[/b][/u]
- new type of gloves and boots
- Ashen enemies and resumoned bosses now can remove your boons after they successfully hit you

notes.title: Version 0.7.42
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
- fixed Arsonist trait not triggering on Focus Fireball
- fixed Aako Portals dialogue not triggering questline progression

[b]Major Changes:[/b]
- improved blood effects
- new type of items which can loot while under effect of Axis Blessing - better version of rare items

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
- new recipe: Relict Helmet of Nahaaz + 3x Athasfar => Helmet of Nahaaz
- new recipe: Relict Bones of King Tal + 3x Athasfar => Ring from King Tal's Bones
- new recipe: Relict Skull of Knight Lar + 3x Athasfar => Giant Skull Helmet
- new recipe: Relict Azik's Medallion + 3x Athasfar => Azik's Medallion
- new recipe: Relict Wand of Artes + 3x Athasfar => Wand of Artes The Architect
- new recipe: Relict Hammer of Olan + 3x Athasfar => Hammer of Olan

notes.title: Version 0.7.41
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
- several minor bugfixes with pathing and map colliders
- fixed bug with World Map controller selection
- fixed bug with enemy target locking where player could accidentally lock enemy behind/out of sight

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
- new item quality: Ascended - similar as Exquisite but adds extra 2 bonuses
- increased difficulty cap for boss resummoning up to 100
- now after beating resummoned boss, you can summon it again without reloading map
- new Petrified Soldier enemy in Road of Forgottens
- new Crossbow undead enemy in Road of Forgottens
- Finishing Strike trait now deals 250% basic damage instead of 125%
- reworked Venom trait
- reworked Confusion trait, now it's named Disorientation.
- reworked Brawler trait
- reworked Arcane trait
- reworked Euphoria trait

notes.title: Version 0.7.40
notes.content:
[u][b]Major Changes:[/b][/u]
- new big area to explore: Tarc Settlement (accessible after passing through Road of Forgottens)

[u][b]Minor Changes:[/b][/u]
- new special shrine in Road of Forgottens which allows for alternative way of leveling
- new enemies
- new base items and new uniques to find
- new NPCs
- new spell scrolls
- increased difficulty of resummoned bosses
- increased items drop chance for resummoned bosses
- Fire Focus spell now applies burning effect

notes.title: Version 0.7.39
notes.content:
[b]Major Changes:[/b]
- new type of items - rare. These can have up to 4 random magic attributes.
- extended Ancient Titan boss fight.

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
- Prayer Focus now grants two random bonuses instead of Fortitude and Precision.
- reworked some of item attributes value ranges.
- reworked runeword items - higher stats but loot less frequently.


All previous release notes can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1054700/discussions/0/3609015230782913079/]here[/url]
